summary.text:
Pit River Land Transfer Act of 2026
This bill takes approximately 557 acres of specified federal land in Shasta County, California, into trust for the benefit of the Pit River Tribe.
The land, known as the Four Corners Property, is currently administered and managed by the Forest Service. Administrative jurisdiction over the land must be transferred to the Department of the Interior. Interior must then take the land into trust for the benefit of the Tribe. The land taken into trust shall be part of the Tribe's reservation.
The bill also prohibits gaming on the land taken into trust.

title: Pit River Land Transfer Act of 2026
